units.source_text: 夜色越来越深。

en.t: The night grew deeper and deeper.

units.source_text: 海风送凉，残月西沉，天空明净如水，人间肃静无声。

en.t: The sea breeze brought coolness, the waning moon sank westward, the sky was clear as water, and the world lay silent and still.

units.source_text: 明石道人便与源氏公子开怀畅叙，无所不谈。

en.t: The Akashi monk then opened his heart to Prince Genji and talked freely with him, leaving nothing unsaid.

units.source_text: 先谈初住此浦时的心情，次述频年为来世修福的功行。

en.t: First he spoke of how he had felt when he first came to live on this shore, and then he described the religious practices by which, over many years, he had sought merit for the next life.

units.source_text: 琐琐屑屑，娓娓不倦，最后连女儿的情况也不问自告了。

en.t: He went on tirelessly about every little detail, and in the end even volunteered the story of his daughter without being asked.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得可笑，然而话中也有深可同情之处。

en.t: Prince Genji found it somewhat amusing, yet there was also much in the man's words that stirred deep sympathy.

units.source_text: 明石道人说：“真不好意思开口：

en.t: The Akashi monk said, "I am truly ashamed to say this, but

units.source_text: 公子降临到这梦想不到的穷乡僻壤来，虽然为期短暂，

en.t: although your lordship's coming to this remote, impoverished place beyond all imagining has lasted only a short while,

units.source_text: 毕竟是我这老道人频年修行积福，蒙神佛垂怜，

en.t: it must, after all, be because this old monk has spent many years in practice and accumulated merit, and has received the compassion of the gods and Buddhas,

units.source_text: 故而暂时奉屈来此受苦的。

en.t: that you have been graciously made to endure hardship here for a time.

units.source_text: 我有一事向住吉明神祈愿，至今已十八年了。

en.t: There is one thing I have prayed for to the Sumiyoshi deity, and it has now been eighteen years.

units.source_text: 我那小女，年幼时我就寄予厚望，

en.t: I placed great hopes in my little daughter from the time she was very young,

units.source_text: 每年春秋二度，带她到住吉神社去参拜明神。

en.t: and twice each year, in spring and autumn, I took her to Sumiyoshi Shrine to worship the deity.

units.source_text: 我昼夜六时诵经礼佛，

en.t: Day and night, at the six appointed hours, I chanted sutras and worshiped the Buddha,

units.source_text: 常把我自己往生极乐之愿放在其次，而首先求神保佑我这女儿，

en.t: always putting my own wish to be reborn in paradise second, and first praying that the gods would protect this daughter of mine,

units.source_text: 使她嫁得贵婿，成遂夙愿。

en.t: so that she might marry a noble husband and fulfill my long-cherished wish.

units.source_text: 我前世作孽，今生做了个可怜的乡村贱民，

en.t: Because of sins from a former life, I have been born in this one as a poor, lowly rustic,

units.source_text: 但我的父亲也曾身居大臣之位。

en.t: but my father once held the rank of minister.

units.source_text: 我这一代已经是田舍平民了。

en.t: By my generation, however, we have already become common people of the countryside.

units.source_text: 今后长此下去，一代不如一代，势将永远沉沦，想起了好不悲伤！

en.t: If things go on like this, each generation will fall below the last and we will sink forever; the thought fills me with grief.

units.source_text: 惟此小女，堕地之后我就寄予厚望，誓愿她将来嫁与京中达官贵人。

en.t: Only for this daughter, from the moment she was born, I placed great hopes in her and vowed that one day she would marry a high-ranking nobleman in the capital.

units.source_text: 因此之故，我得罪了许多身份相应的求婚人，

en.t: For that reason, I offended many suitors whose status would have matched hers,

units.source_text: 对我自身亦多不利，然而并不引以为苦。

en.t: and it brought me much disadvantage as well, yet I never regarded it as a hardship.

units.source_text: 只要我一息尚存，虽然腕力薄弱，誓必爱护到底。

en.t: As long as breath remains in me, though my strength is slight, I swear I will cherish and protect her to the end.

units.source_text: 万一良缘未得，而我身先死，则我早有遗命：

en.t: If, by some misfortune, she has not found a good match and I die before her, I have already left these instructions:

units.source_text: 与其嫁与庸夫，不如投身海底，长与波臣为伍。”

en.t: rather than marry her to an ordinary man, let her cast herself into the depths of the sea and live forever among the servants of the waves."

units.source_text: 说时声泪俱下。

en.t: As he spoke, both his voice and his tears broke forth.

units.source_text: 种种伤心之言，难于尽述。

en.t: All the sorrowful things he said are too many to recount in full.
